d: The Philippines has deployed India’s BrahMos supersonic anti-ship missile battery in northern Luzon, placing Chinese naval vessels operating near the Luzon Strait within its reach. The deployment marks the first confirmed fielding of the system and comes amid rising tensions between Manila and Beijing in the South China Sea. In this video, Firstpost examines why the Philippines has chosen this strategic location, how the BrahMos could threaten Chinese warships and the role of the United States in strengthening Manila’s defences.
